scene: The brass key unlocks the sky terminal gates, revealing three ready departures.
picture: A flat side view along the wooden sky dock platform. Far left, a long red maglev dragon train idles on glowing rails. Left of centre, the Pacific Islander player holds his brass key and ukulele. Centre, a sleek white bullet train waits with doors open. Far right, a wooden junk boat rests with amber sails.
shown: a winding red maglev dragon train on the far left
a sleek white bullet train waiting with open doors at centre
a wooden solar-sail junk tied to the platform at far right
